verdict.rationale: Asynchronous human approval of agent transactions is a fair question for an auth provider, but the evidence pack does not document CIBA or any out-of-band approval flow. The closest items are adjacent: MFA with TOTP or phone at sign-in, and Postgres auth hooks at lifecycle points. Neither provides per-transaction asynchronous human confirmation for an autonomous agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require asynchronous human approval (e.g. CIBA-style confirmation) before an autonomous agent completes a sensitive transaction
